about: WS2 PR4 Type 1 filing-reader panel (decision Item 70). Identity, SHA-256 and expected values only; the PDFs stay in ignored research/pending-filing-pdfs/panel. Every row is assistant_draft until a person checks it against the cited page and sets human_verified.
label_rules: A field is labelled only when the filing states one unambiguous value for the proposed project; a self-contradiction or a prose-only mention is left unlabelled.
from_district/to_district come from the ordinance (Legislation) clause, never the narrative; two source districts leave from_district unlabelled; every 'to those of' must name the same district.
Districts are written as normalize_district writes them (RS-3, RT-3.5, PD 1492).
Numbers are copied as printed with commas removed (stated decimals kept; '.78' is written 0.78). No arithmetic and no unit conversion.
far is the project's FAR. A row labelled Base/Maximum/Allowed FAR is the district's figure and is not labelled.

dwelling_units needs a dwelling/residential unit-count label ('None' is 0); a parenthetical in a density row is not labelled; a table that counts non-zero efficiency units separately is not labelled (refined while labelling held-out O2025-0018857, whose efficiency count is 0).
height is labelled only in whole or decimal feet (X'-0" counts as X); feet plus non-zero inches is not representable as a plain foot value and is not labelled.
parking is automobile/off-street parking (bicycle and loading excluded); 'zero'/'none' is 0.
page is the 1-based PDF page within the cited attachment.
split_rule: held_out iff int(sha256(record_number)[:8], 16) % 3 == 0 (eval.filing_panel.split_for), fixed before labelling; a record read during parser development before the split moves to train with a note.
